names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 2212, «Феодосий Сирмийский, мч.», with the rank word left off. The day’s own line declines the forename and gives no city, «Мчч. Мануила и Феодосия (304)».

death.note: The year both the day line and the life give: «Мчч. Мануила и Феодосия (304)» and «пострадали за веру во Христа в 304 году в Сирмии». Neither page gives a year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 27 марта ст. ст. — «Мчч. Мануила и Феодосия (304)»

attestations.note: Name page 2212 gives «День памяти: 27 марта» and nothing else, so no second day is owed. He was NOT identified with the corpus's `theodosius-of-the-east`, which stands on saint.gr's «Άγιοι Κοδράτος, Θεοδόσιος, Μανουήλ και άλλοι Τεσσαράκοντα μάρτυρες από την Ανατολή» on the Greek 26 March: that entry has a third named man and forty unnamed ones and gives no year and no city, where this one gives 304 and Sirmium and names a pair alone. Whether the two pairs are one pair is an author question, stated and not decided. The corpus's other Sirmium folders — `irenaeus-of-sirmium`, `basilissa-of-sirmium` and `seventy-three-martyrs-of-sirmium` — are on other days, and no reading was made across them either. The day page prints no hymn at all. azbyka.ru was not read.
